status: Supplemental scaling study registered after the primary test, before any scaling-domain timing
question: Does the fixed hybrid exact join retain a native C++ query advantage on longer compositions, and how much does index construction cost?
policy: The hybrid is fixed. No further learning or tuning is allowed from these cases.
goal_filter: Exclude targets in the half-bank; disclose saturation without replacing domains.
analysis: Paired per-domain native CPU medians and geometric ratios. Warm results exclude preparation; cold estimates charge the entire shared C++ index union to hybrid and no preprocessing to pairwise as a conservative bound. Include Python semantic bank construction time equally for both.
limits: Synthetic finite domains; the selected learner was already identical to the fixed hybrid in the primary study. This study cannot establish learned algorithm discovery.
